articles.title: RBI invites comments on the Draft “Reserve Bank of India (Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026”
articles.summary: Draft amendment directions covering temporary debit holds on accounts linked to money-mule activity and cyber-enabled fraud, open for public feedback until October 2, 2026.

articles.title: RBI to conduct Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on September 15, 2026
articles.summary: RBI scheduled a one-day Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction for September 15, 2026 as part of routine liquidity management under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility.

articles.title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Asset Care & Reconstruction Enterprise Limited
articles.summary: RBI fined Asset Care & Reconstruction Enterprise Limited ₹27.30 lakh for non-compliance with its directions on income recognition, following a statutory inspection.

articles.title: Successful launch of “Demat 2.0” pilot project for tokenised corporate bonds
articles.source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
articles.summary: SEBI announced the pilot launch of “Demat 2.0” for tokenised corporate bonds, alongside an FAQ document for market participants.

articles.title: SEBI Chairman delivers keynote address and joins panel discussion at Global Fintech Fest 2026
articles.source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
articles.summary: SEBI's Chairman spoke at Global Fintech Fest 2026, addressing developments in India's securities-market technology.

articles.title: Winners of the Securities Market TechSprint felicitated at Global Fintech Fest 2026
articles.source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
articles.summary: SEBI felicitated the winning teams of its Securities Market TechSprint innovation challenge at Global Fintech Fest 2026.
